purpose: Baseline package identity for issue #28 Stage 1. The rebuilt packages are compared against these digests; the paired benchmark's baseline arm installs exactly this commit.

builder.source: repository worktree at base_commit; plugins/, core/ and shared/ clean (git status --porcelain empty for those paths)
builder.isolation: HOME, XDG_STATE_HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME and --prefix were set to paths below a fresh temporary directory; the real user directory and prefix were not read or written.
builder.repeat_build: The same command into <scratch>/prefix2 produced byte-identical install-manifest.json files for every plugin.
builder.post_check: python3 bench/tools/verify_package.py <tmp>/prefix/<plugin>/<version> reported ok for every plugin (no missing, modified or unlisted files)
builder.cross_check: git archive <base_commit> | tar -x -C <scratch>/src; python3 scripts/install.py --plugin <plugin> --prefix <scratch>/prefix --source <scratch>/src. Without Git, version label uses +content.<12 hex>; package_content_sha256 matched listed values.

digest_definitions.package_content_sha256: sha256 of json.dumps(manifest['files'], sort_keys=True).encode(), the installer's own content hash (plan_install `content`). Independent of Git provenance and of the version label.
digest_definitions.install_manifest_sha256: sha256 of the installed install-manifest.json bytes, which also binds version and source_commit.
digest_definitions.version: plugin.json version plus +g<12-hex commit>: the last commit that touched plugins/<plugin>, core or shared. It is a provenance label, not the base commit.

limits: Digests identify package bytes only. They say nothing about provider behaviour.
No managed worker definitions or agent bundles exist at this commit; the baseline arm has no bundle identity.
